Description: Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model - a proprietary AI-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass-box architecture, it uses market data - not personal data - with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. • We're looking for a Data Scientist to help us grow our advanced analytics team's capabilities. The ideal candidate is a data scientist with a relevant experience who is self-driven, motivated, independent and sharp • Design and operationalize causal-uplift measurement frameworks to quantify the incremental impact of pricing models • Lead data discovery and translate complex multidimensional data into actionable insights related to the pricing algorithms and their outcomes • Conduct research and experimentation to elaborate novel approaches to uplift measuring and a/b testing • Collaborate with revenue managers, data analysts, data engineers in order to encode airline business logic into modeling and technical pipelines • At Fetcherr, the Insights & Decision Science (IDS) team is where data meets storytelling. We take the hard work of our AI pricing engine and translate it into something airlines can actually see, trust, and act on — think rigorous statistical analysis with a human touch. If a number moves, we explain why. If a client has a question, we have the answer (and the chart to back it up). • Requirements: • * You have at least 5 years of hands-on data analytics & science experience with proven record of leveraging modeling into business insights • * You are proficient in Python (typical data analytics and machine learning stack: pandas, numpy, scikit, statsmodels) • * You know to assess the performance and impact of the ML-powered system from business environments perspective • * You have great communication and storytelling skills to both technical and non-technical audiences (ability to present to C level stakeholders executives as well) • *You are experienced in translating complex client requirements into actionable insights, and ability to present findings and strategies to stakeholders • *You are able to provide and recommend innovative solutions and approaches to non-trivial challenges • *You’re a team player, ready to help others meeting aggressive timelines and motivate the team to meet the product deadlines • *B.SC or Master’s degree in Economy / Statistics / Math or similar (Phd is a plus) • You are proficient in using SQL (BigQuery / Dataform / GCP experience is a plus) and git • Great if you have them: • Domain knowledge in following industries: airlines, transportation, logistics or vacations • Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, anomaly detection or pricing algorithms • Knowledge in mathematical optimization •

Senior Data Analyst – Demand Planning / Supply Chain Location: Rishon LeZion, Israel Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site Analytical Factor is looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our team in Rishon LeZion. We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented professional with strong data analysis skills. Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning, Forecasting, Inventory Planning, or related areas is highly preferred. This is a full-time, on-site position and is ideal for someone who enjoys working with complex business data, identifying patterns and trends, and translating data into meaningful insights that support business and planning decisions. Key Responsibilities • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business insights • Support demand planning, forecasting, supply chain, and business planning initiatives • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis • Develop analytical reports, models, and dashboards to support business decisions • Work closely with consultants, developers, and customers to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions • Investigate data and forecast-related issues and recommend practical solutions • Support implementation and optimization of planning and forecasting solutions • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders Requirements • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analytics, supply chain analytics, or a related field • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel • Strong experience working with large datasets • Experience with SQL and relational databases • Ability to independently investigate data issues and reach logical conclusions • Strong attention to detail and accuracy • Excellent communication skills • Strong English skills, both written and verbal • Ability to work full-time from our Rishon LeZion office Preferred Qualifications • Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning, Forecasting, Inventory Planning, S&OP, or related functions • Experience with statistical forecasting or demand forecasting • Experience with Oracle supply chain or planning applications, including Oracle Demantra or Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning , is a strong advantage • Experience with BI/reporting tools or Python is an advantage • Experience working directly with business users or customers is an advantage Important This is a full-time, on-site position in Rishon LeZion . It is not a remote or hybrid position. Because this is a full-time professional role, it is not suitable for candidates who are currently students in an academic institution . Our office is a non-smoking workplace . Smoking breaks outside of the company's regular scheduled breaks cannot be accommodated. If you are an experienced data analyst looking to expand your expertise in demand planning, forecasting, and supply chain analytics, we would be happy to hear from you.

Experience level: Intermediate. Description: About Cyera • Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI. AI has changed how data is used — and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security. • About the Team • The Competitive Intelligence team is responsible for analyzing the competitive landscape across the market. The team focuses on understanding how competitor products work, evaluating technical claims, and identifying strengths, gaps, and risks. It works closely with Product Management, R&D, Sales, and Marketing to provide evidence-based insights that support product decisions, competitive positioning, and customer conversations. • The team’s output includes technical analyses, competitive reports, and materials used across the company to inform strategy and execution. • About the Role • We seek a highly skilled Technical Competitive Intelligence Analyst to analyze and evaluate competitors' products. This role includes understanding our competitors' technical landscapes and providing insights that inform Cyera's product roadmap, enhance our competitive positioning, and drive innovation in data security solutions. • What You’ll Do • Analyze identity security products in depth, including their architectures, technology stacks, and key features across NHI, agentic identity, IGA, and adjacent PAM and ISPM. • Gather and synthesize competitive intelligence from field input, customer feedback, analyst reports, call intelligence, CRM data, and public sources to assess competitor claims and understand which vendors appear in deals, at what stage, and how we win. • Monitor competitor product updates, announcements, acquisitions, and new market entrants. Day to day

  • The Senior Scientist, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations builds the software our scientists use to run real-world evidence analyses more efficiently, and makes sure the answers are right. These are epidemiology and statistics applications: cohort builders, incidence and prevalence estimates, treatment-pattern analyses, descriptive study reports. A tool like that can run perfectly and still be wrong, if a lookback window is off or a denominator is incorrectly defined. So this role pairs software development with enough epidemiology and statistics to know what a correct result looks like. This person owns each tool’s analytical logic, its test sets and its acceptance criteria, and builds the tools themselves with agentic coding tools. They build on the company’s shared AI and data platforms, which the data science and IT teams run
  • Build epidemiology and statistics applications that scientists use directly, from a simple front end to the analysis code behind it
  • Implements each tool’s analytical logic: cohort entry, lookback and follow-up windows, denominators and statistical methods, agreed with the RWE scientists who will use the output
  • Write the known-answer test sets and acceptance criteria every tool must pass before release, drawn from published studies and past analyses, and rerun them whenever the data or the code changes
  • Turn validated analyses and agentic workflows that work for one person into tools the function can use, for tasks like literature screening or drafting code lists, with a person checking the output before it is used
  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely, and review what they produce as closely as a colleague’s work
  • Align tools to the appropriate platforms and workstreams required (exploratory vs. regulatory submissions)
  • Work with the data science and IT teams that run the shared AI and data platforms when a tool needs enterprise deployment
  • Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it
  • Real-World Data Foundation
  • Build on the curated, analysis-ready data, standard cohorts and code lists that the real-world data curation team maintains
  • Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks
  • Support the design of standardized workflows which support complex observational studies and analytical strategies
  • Good understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose evidence approaches
  • Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions
  • Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions
  • Translate analyses into clear, actionable insights for decision-making
  • Support study- and program-level decisions on evidence generation, data selection and analytical strategy
  • Help ensure evidence is relevant to the question being asked and the decision it is meant to support
  • Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT
  • Work with IT and the enterprise data, AI and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so tools meet company architecture and security standards
  • Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier

Role Overview The Senior Scientist, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations builds the software our scientists use to run real-world evidence analyses more efficiently, and makes sure the answers are right. These are epidemiology and statistics applications: cohort builders, incidence and prevalence estimates, treatment-pattern analyses, descriptive study reports. A tool like that can run perfectly and still be wrong, if a lookback window is off or a denominator is incorrectly defined. So this role pairs software development with enough epidemiology and statistics to know what a correct result looks like. This person owns each tool’s analytical logic, its test sets and its acceptance criteria, and builds the tools themselves with agentic coding tools. They build on the company’s shared AI and data platforms, which the data science and IT teams run. Key Responsibilities Real-World Evidence Tools Build epidemiology and statistics applications that scientists use directly, from a simple front end to the analysis code behind it. Implements each tool’s analytical logic: cohort entry, lookback and follow-up windows, denominators and statistical methods, agreed with the RWE scientists who will use the output. Write the known-answer test sets and acceptance criteria every tool must pass before release, drawn from published studies and past analyses, and rerun them whenever the data or the code changes. Turn validated analyses and agentic workflows that work for one person into tools the function can use, for tasks like literature screening or drafting code lists, with a person checking the output before it is used. Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely, and review what they produce as closely as a colleague’s work. Align tools to the appropriate platforms and workstreams required (exploratory vs. regulatory submissions). Work with the data science and IT teams that run the shared AI and data platforms when a tool needs enterprise deployment. Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it. Real-World Data Foundation Build on the curated, analysis-ready data, standard cohorts and code lists that the real-world data curation team maintains Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks. Scientific & Strategic Leadership Support the design of standardized workflows which support complex observational studies and analytical strategies. Good understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose evidence approaches. Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions. Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions. Decision Enablement Translate analyses into clear, actionable insights for decision-making. Support study- and program-level decisions on evidence generation, data selection and analytical strategy. Help ensure evidence is relevant to the question being asked and the decision it is meant to support. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT. Work with IT and the enterprise data, AI and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so tools meet company architecture and security standards. Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier. Minimum Qualifications PhD, or a Master’s degree with equivalent experience, in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field. 8+ years in real-world evidence, epidemiology, biostatistics or health data science, including hands-on development of analytical software that other people use. Hands-on work with claims, EHR or registry data, and knowledge of how the way it is collected shapes confounding, missingness and misclassification. Working knowledge of the epidemiological and statistical methods used in observational research, such as cohort designs, incidence and prevalence, survival analysis and confounding adjustment. Strong Python and SQL, written with software engineering habits such as Git, automated testing and code review. Enough R to read and port analysts’ code. Regular hands-on use of agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code on real projects, with the testing and review habits that keep the output trustworthy. Clear communication of analytical and technical choices to scientists and decision makers. Preferred Qualifications Turning a validated analysis program into a reusable tool. OMOP CDM and OHDSI analytics tools. Building or evaluating LLM-based agents or workflows. Modern web front-end development. Experience with Israeli health data sources. Computerized system validation (GxP) or other regulated software practice. A publication record or open-source contributions in real-world evidence methods or tooling. What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress! Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

What you’ll need

  • PhD, or a Master’s degree with equivalent experience, in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field
  • 8+ years in real-world evidence, epidemiology, biostatistics or health data science, including hands-on development of analytical software that other people use
  • Hands-on work with claims, EHR or registry data, and knowledge of how the way it is collected shapes confounding, missingness and misclassification
  • Working knowledge of the epidemiological and statistical methods used in observational research, such as cohort designs, incidence and prevalence, survival analysis and confounding adjustment
  • Strong Python and SQL, written with software engineering habits such as Git, automated testing and code review. Enough R to read and port analysts’ code
  • Regular hands-on use of agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code on real projects, with the testing and review habits that keep the output trustworthy
  • Clear communication of analytical and technical choices to scientists and decision makers
  • Turning a validated analysis program into a reusable tool plus
  • OMOP CDM and OHDSI analytics tools plus
  • Building or evaluating LLM-based agents or workflows plus
  • Modern web front-end development plus
  • Experience with Israeli health data sources plus
  • Computerized system validation (GxP) or other regulated software practice plus
  • A publication record or open-source contributions in real-world evidence methods or tooling plus

Merck HealthcareAssociate Director RWD Scientist newSQLPythonRData modelingGitStatisticsCohorts & LTVYavne8+MSc1d ago

Day to day

  • The Associate Director, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations makes licensed real-world data fit for the studies and insights that depend on it. Claims, electronic health records are collected for care and billing, not for research. Each source brings its own challenges for new applications: gaps in enrollment, delayed resolution of claims, shifts between diagnosis coding versions. This person owns the path from a new data delivery to curated, documented, analysis-ready data a scientist can trust, and knows which of those problems matters for which question. They work on data platforms that IT and the enterprise platform teams own and run and bring the real-world data expertise those platforms need. Agentic AI coding tools are part of how they work every day
  • Assess each licensed claims, EHR and registry source for fitness for purpose before it is used: what it captures, and which questions it can and cannot answer
  • Build and run the ingestion and curation pipelines that turn each delivery into analysis-ready data, handling enrollment and eligibility periods, claims lag and adjudication, and changes between coding-system versions
  • Keep intact the details that change results, such as the decimal in an ICD-10 code, and document every transformation so a reviewer can trace any result back to the source files
  • Map sources to common data models such as OMOP where reuse justifies it, and maintain the code lists, phenotype definitions and linkage rules that studies share
  • Build standard cohorts and variables, with lookback and washout windows defined, so recurring questions do not start from raw data
  • Check data quality and automated conformance, completeness and plausibility checks to inform each source’s fitness-for-purpose assessment
  • Work with the platform teams on how each source is loaded, stored and refreshed, so a new data cut does not mean weeks of rework and routine cohort queries come back quickly
  • Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks
  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely to write and test curation code, and maintain responsibility to review for quality and accuracy
  • Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it
  • Lead the design of standardized workflows which support complex non-interventional real-world studies and analytical strategies
  • Strong understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose real-world evidence approaches
  • Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions
  • Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions
  • Translate repeatable analyses into clear, actionable insights for decision-making using standardized approaches
  • Support portfolio-level decisions on evidence generation, data selection and analytical strategy
  • Help ensure standardized evidence approaches are relevant to the questions being asked and the decisions they’re meant to support
  • Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT
  • Work with IT and the enterprise data and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so curation work fits company architecture and security standards
  • Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier

Experience level: Entry-level. Description: • About RealPlay • RealPlay is a fast-growing Tel Aviv startup in the gaming industry. At the heart of how we operate is a deep understanding of our players, and that depends on clean, trustworthy data. That's where you come in. • The Role • We have petabytes of data, but data isn't insight. Your mission is to be the bridge between raw information and strategic action. This isn't about being a "dashboard provider" - you will be measured by the quality of insights you generate; it's about creating "aha!" moments by going beyond the "what" to uncover the "why" that drives player behavior and shapes our success. • In this role, you will: • Be a strategic partner to our product, design, and leadership teams. Your job is to bring them not just answers, but better questions. You'll translate your findings into compelling, actionable recommendations that catalyze new features, better experiences, and smarter business decisions . • Hypothesize, test, and build frameworks to understand how our economy thrives and how player incentives drive long-term engagement. • Embark on deep research projects to deconstruct our most complex business questions. Your deliverable will be a compelling narrative, backed by rigorous analysis, that guides our strategic business roadmap. • Focus on what’s important. We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative. • Requirements: Who You Are: • You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths. • You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior. • You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. However, you are eager to be challenged and ready to be convinced by new evidence or a better argument. • You can effortlessly translate a complex statistical model into a clear, persuasive story for any audience (with an emphasis on C-level executives). • You are resourceful and self-driven , comfortable navigating uncertainty and motivated to find a path forward even when the way isn't clear. • ﻿Instrumental Skills & Experience: • The journey from a complex question to a clear insight is often accelerated by the right tools. Experience with the following is useful for this role (though not required): • A solid understanding of experimental design and A/B testing methodologies. • Proficiency in querying large datasets (e.g., strong SQL skills). • Experience using a scripting language like Python for data analysis. • Familiarity with user analytics/data visualization tools (e.g., Looker). •

Position Summary We are looking for a Data Science and AI builder with a strong background in applied machine learning, experience working with real business data, and a product-oriented mindset. In this role, you will transform game, player, and operational data into models and analytical products that support business decisions, from problem definition and feature engineering to model evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. The role requires hands-on modeling skills and the ability to clearly explain assumptions, evaluation methods, uncertainty, and model limitations. Key Responsibilities Translate business questions into measurable modeling objectives, hypotheses, baselines, and success criteria. Prepare and explore data, define labels, engineer features, and identify data-quality issues, leakage, bias, and missing data. Build and compare models for regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, ranking, and segmentation. Design robust evaluations using holdout sets, cross-validation, backtesting, error analysis, and business-relevant metrics. Collaborate with product owners, analysts, game teams, and operations to define the decisions each model will support. Connect model performance to business outcomes and operational thresholds. Apply LLM and agent capabilities when they improve workflows or products. Deliver production-ready solutions with testing, documentation, versioning, and appropriate review processes. Requirements 2–3 years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or a related field, including ownership of at least one model from development through evaluation. Experience with problem formulation, feature engineering, algorithm selection, tuning, validation, and error analysis. Strong Python and SQL skills, with hands-on experience using pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or similar libraries. Solid foundations in statistics and model evaluation, including sampling, cross-validation, leakage, class imbalance, uncertainty, and causal limitations. Practical experience in at least one area such as forecasting, anomaly detection, classification, regression, segmentation, or ranking. Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar tools for building working products. Experience productionizing models through scheduled workflows, services, or APIs, and monitoring data quality, model performance, drift, and failures. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, results, tradeoffs, and limitations to business partners. Experience in mobile gaming, social casino, live operations, game analytics, or another data-intensive consumer product domain.

About the role We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build the prediction engine behind our staffing platform. You'll report directly to our VP R&D and work on real hospital data that directly shapes how nurses are scheduled. Census prediction: forecast how many patients each hospital unit will have, shift by shift, from hours to weeks ahead, using admissions, discharges, transfers, seasonality and hospital-specific patterns. Patient acuity: model how sick patients are and how much nursing care they need, based on clinical data such as vitals, diagnoses, orders and nursing assessments. Nursing workload: combine census and acuity into workload predictions that drive how nurse shifts are planned and assigned. Clinical data: work hands-on with EHR records and ADT feeds from hospitals: messy, incomplete and full of signal. Own models end to end , from exploration and validation to production and monitoring. Data Analyst – Product Data & AI Quality • At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. • Our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. • In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people. • We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our R&D department! • Why is this role so important at Similarweb? • Our Retail Intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. Behind them is data collected from retailers and marketplaces around the world, each describing products in its own way. We use LLMs and ML models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view. • As a Data Analyst on the team, you’ll be the person who knows this data best. You’ll own its quality: defining what “correct” looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. You’ll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our LLM and ML pipelines, and with Product, turning what you find into clear priorities. Your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients. • It’s a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses AI tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product. • So, what will you be doing all day? • Your daily responsibilities may include: • Analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy • Defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time • Building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes • Evaluating the output of LLM and ML models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements • Using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review • Helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with Product • Supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients • Validating new data sources before they are added to the product • Partnering with Product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities • This is the perfect job for someone who: • Holds a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field • Has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company • Has strong SQL skills • Uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - Must • Has a solid understanding of statistics and evaluation metrics: sampling, precision/recall, confidence levels • Has hands-on experience using LLMs for data work, such as prompting, structured outputs or reviewing model outputs • Has strong attention to detail and a structured approach to messy, ambiguous data • Communicates clearly in English and can present findings to Product, engineering and customer-facing teams • Has experience with labeling, taxonomies or data quality processes (advantage) • Has experience with e-commerce or product data (advantage) • Has experience with BI and visualization tools (advantage) • At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role The Special Capabilities Analyst will be responsible for coordinating and applying advanced research capabilities for the Nebius Global Intelligence team, with the aim of strengthening the company’s understanding of complex business, digital, and international environments. The role combines the management of specialized research assignments, collaboration with professional partners and vendors, and the use of diverse research tools, sources, and methodologies. Responsibilities include understanding the business need, developing an appropriate research approach, coordinating execution, and assessing the quality, reliability, and relevance of the resulting deliverables. The Analyst will integrate information and findings from different sources and areas of expertise, identify relationships, patterns, and trends, and transform them into a clear picture that supports assessments and decision-making. The role requires research and operational experience, technological understanding, the ability to manage external interfaces, sound judgment, and discretion when handling sensitive information. Your responsibilities will include: Manage and coordinate complex research assignments, from receiving the initial requirement through delivery of the final product to the internal stakeholder. Translate the department’s information needs into clear work plans and assignments for external providers and professional specialists. Work closely with research firms, information providers, and professional partners across a range of specialized fields. Conduct research across diverse digital environments, including social media, online communities, foreign-language sources, and specialized information sources. Use advanced research tools and technological capabilities to expand coverage and identify information not captured through standard monitoring tools. Identify and analyze relevant individuals and entities, relationships, trends, activity patterns, and online developments of potential significance to the company. Plan and coordinate tailored research approaches using providers, sources, and professional capabilities suited to the requirements of each assignment. Verify and cross-reference findings obtained from different sources and information channels and assess their reliability and significance. Integrate findings into a clear research picture and prepare assessments, profiles, and briefings for the intelligence team and internal stakeholders. Manage the quality of work performed by providers and professional partners, including monitoring compliance with requirements, timelines, and expected deliverable standards. Maintain structured documentation and ensure discretion and responsible handling of sensitive information throughout the research process. We expect you to have: 5+ years of experience in commercial intelligence or specialized research firms, including hands-on responsibility for managing integrated research and collection activities. Previous experience in an intelligence role within a relevant state, government, or public-sector environment. Demonstrated experience planning, coordinating, and managing complex research assignments involving multiple methods, sources, and providers. In-depth understanding and practical research experience across the Dark Web, closed digital communities, social media, and online communication platforms. Experience conducting human-source research (HUMINT), interviews, or structured professional engagement with relevant sources. Experience managing research firms, information providers, and external professional capabilities, including tasking, professional oversight, and deliverable assessment. Demonstrated ability to verify and cross-reference information, integrate findings from different sources, and develop a clear research picture. Full professional proficiency in Russian, including the ability to read, understand, and analyze complex content. Excellent command of English, including the ability to write, brief, and present findings to a high professional standard. Strong familiarity with cyber intelligence sources, digital environments, and technological tools used for research and information collection. Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information and complex assignments responsibly. Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments while meeting deadlines and adapting to changing priorities. It will be an added bonus if you have: Experience in a managerial role or leading teams, providers, or multidisciplinary research activities. Experience working in a global business environment, technology company, or with corporate clients. Familiarity with cyber intelligence as a research source only, digital threats, coordinated campaigns, and foreign influence. Experience using artificial intelligence tools, advanced research platforms, and professional databases. Proficiency in Chinese or another foreign language. About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to drive product decisions with data. You'll research how developers and companies discover, adopt and get value from Tavily and find the drivers behind them . You'll work as a thought partner to Product, R&D and leadership and shape what we build next and why. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You take a question from start to finish: you frame the problem, build the data you need, run the analysis or model, and come back with a clear recommendation. You are expected to understand the need and show people results they didn't even knew they wanted or needed and be an integrational part in decision making. You'll work closely with the analysts on the team and with Product, Engineering, Growth and GTM. What You'll Do Own product analytics end-to-end: define, instrument and measure the product funnel, from first API call through activation, feature adoption, retention and conversion to paid. Drive product decisions: work with PMs and R&D leads to set success metrics, size opportunities, prioritize the roadmap, and measure the impact of what we ship. Uncover the drivers behind top-level KPIs: which behaviors, use cases, endpoints and product experiences predict activation, retention and expansion. Design, run and evaluate experiments (A/B tests, onboarding flows, pricing and packaging changes) and apply advanced statistical models when needed. Build the data you need: model raw product, usage and billing data into trusted, reusable datasets with SQL, dbt and Python and more. Apply predictive and statistical modeling (segmentation, propensity, forecasting, classification and clustering) where it sharpens product decisions. Proactively monitor key product metrics, investigate trends and anomalies, and surface insights stakeholders can act on. Set the standard for how we measure product success: metric definitions, a shared source of truth and analytical rigor across teams. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst or Data Scientist, including at least 2 years in a product-facing role. 2+ years in a SaaS or tech product company, with deep understanding of funnels, cohorts, engagement, retention and monetization. A proven record of driving product decisions through data: you've shaped roadmaps, launches or strategy, not just reported on them. Comfort working with large, messy, event-level datasets. Strong hands-on experience using Python for data analysis, experimentation and data modeling in a production environment. Strong statistical foundations. Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy through data and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, including executive leadership. Strong communication: you can turn complex analysis into a clear, compelling story and a concrete recommendation. Experience with modern data tooling (Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, and BI tools like Omni/Looker/Tableau). BSc in Statistics / Math / CS / Industrial Engineering or equivalent. Nice to Have Experience at an API-first, developer-focused or PLG company. Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models. Familiarity with LLMs / AI tooling, and using AI agents to speed up your own analytical work. Evidence that you build things on your own: a GitHub profile, portfolio, side projects or publications. MSc in Statistics / Math / CS or equivalent. ABOUT SEATPICK SeatPick is a profitable, fast-growing ticket comparison platform for live events. We help fans find the best tickets to sports, concerts and festivals by comparing listings from dozens of trusted resale sites in one place. More than 30 million fans use SeatPick every year, in 195 countries. We are a product-first, AI-first B2C company. THE ROLE This is our first data hire. We hold a deep dataset: millions of events and listings from dozens of marketplaces, prices that move all day, and every search, click and booking our fans make. Almost none of it is modelled today. You will build our data foundation from zero and own it end to end, working closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering and Commercial. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Choose the data stack (warehouse, ingestion, transformation, BI) and explain the choices. - Build and own pipelines and data models for marketplace, pricing, customer and marketing data. - Create a single source of truth, with clear metric definitions and documentation. - Turn business questions into reliable answers, with dashboards and KPIs that teams use to make decisions. - Enable reliable measurement of funnel performance, CAC, ROAS, LTV and cohorts. - Set data quality and monitoring standards, and find breakage before stakeholders do. - Work with Product and Engineering to capture the right events. - Use AI and agentic tools where they add value, so one person can cover the work of a team. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in BI development, analytics engineering or data engineering. - Hands-on experience building data pipelines and data models, not only dashboards. - Expert SQL and working knowledge of Python. - Experience with a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift) and dbt or similar. - Strong experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar) and building a reporting layer people trust. - Experience with B2C data: funnels, marketing, user behavior and cohorts. - Comfortable as the first and only data person: you decide, build and own the outcome. - Credible with business stakeholders: you scope, push back and reframe the question. ADVANTAGES - Background in a B2C marketplace, e-commerce, travel, ticketing or gaming company. - Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster). - Experience connecting acquisition platforms (Google, Meta) with first-party data. - Experience as a first data hire or in a small data team. WHY SEATPICK - Profitable and growing: decisions made on merit, not runway. - Real ownership and autonomy in a small, fast team. - Work around what people love: sports, music and live events worldwide. - You set the architecture, the tools and the standards. - Interesting data: live inventory, dynamic pricing and demand that changes by the hour.

ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines analytical rigor, strong business judgment, and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll own analytical projects end to end from defining the question and preparing the data to developing analytical models, validating findings, and influencing decisions. The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and creating products that build trust in cryptocurrencies. We’re a global organization with teams in Denmark, UK, Canada, the USA who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes every day and our job is to create user facing products supported by a flexible and scalable data platform allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring value to our customers. We are building the data platform https://blog.chainalysis.com/reports/series-f/ for blockchain, cryptocurrency, and web3. Our engineers deeply understand what is possible with cloud-native technologies and use those insights to enable our customers to push the boundaries of the cryptocurrency landscape. Our Alterya team is focused on AI-powered fintech and threat intelligence, empowering institutions to protect individuals from fraud transactions. As a Data Analyst & Prompt Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing prompts for LLM models to efficiently extract the data the team needs. We are looking for someone who thinks outside the box and enjoys solving complex problems with simple, elegant solutions. You are naturally curious, highly independent, and a self-learner who is always exploring new ideas and expanding your knowledge. The role will be based in Tel Aviv, and we are looking for eager, enthusiastic, curious, hard working and positive people to be part of our amazing journey. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it. AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before. ℹ️ How the tags on this board are computed

Everything is extracted deterministically from the posting text — a fixed keyword lexicon and header rules, no AI guessing. A tag can be missing simply because the posting never stated it; postings without a captured description show no tags at all.

Skills are matched from a curated 98-term lexicon and grouped into non-overlapping clusters: SQL & Databases, ETL & Infrastructure, Coding, ML & Statistics, Visualization & BI, Other. Hover any tag for its meaning.

MUST / PLUS badges mirror the posting’s own wording (“a must”, “an advantage”, חובה / יתרון) — absence of a badge means the posting didn’t mark that line. Years is the experience figure stated nearest to “experience”. Degree shows the level and fields asked for; “plus” means the posting itself calls the degree an advantage.

Day-to-day groups classify the responsibilities section: Instrument & manage tracking (Setting up event tracking, taxonomies and instrumentation) · Assure data quality (Validation, anomaly detection, alerting — keeping the data trustworthy) · Run experiments & build models (A/B tests, statistical models and forecasts) · Define metrics & KPIs (Owning metric definitions — the single source of truth for KPIs) · Build pipelines & data models (ETL, warehouse models and analytical infrastructure) · Build dashboards & track performance (Dashboards, recurring reports and performance tracking) · Analyze & recommend (Deep dives and analysis that end in insights and recommendations) · Partner & present (Working with business teams — gathering needs, presenting findings). A chip appears only when a group matches multiple responsibility bullets — it marks an emphasis of the role, not a passing mention — and chips are ordered by how dominant each theme is.

🤖 AI usage classifies what the analyst is expected to do with AI, judged from the words around each AI mention: AI for efficiency (Expected to use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor…) to work faster) · AI for automation (Using AI to automate processes and workflows) · Building with AI (Building AI/LLM-powered features, models or data products) · AI (unspecified) (AI mentioned without a specific use identified). WHERE the mention sits matters: in the requirements section it is prior experience you must bring; in the responsibilities it is part of the job — learnable, not a bar to entry. The dashboard and chips keep the two apart. Mentions of the company’s own AI product (“analyze our AI agents”) are deliberately NOT counted — that is product analysis, not AI usage.

Soft skills (dotted chips) are tagged from the requirements section only — the person the posting describes, separate from the toolbox: communication, ownership, business acumen, curiosity, and so on. Hover any chip for its meaning.

reposted marks a posting whose date was bumped 3+ days after this board first saw it, with the original date in the card.
